title: DSA — Easy Tier
description: Arrays, strings, hash maps/sets, two pointers, basic recursion. The bread-and-butter of Turing coding, Andela HackerRank, Toptal Codility Lesson 1-3.

questions.prompt: Two Sum: given `nums` and `target`, return indices of two numbers that add to `target`. Assume exactly one solution.
Valid Anagram: return true if `s` and `t` contain the same characters with the same counts.
Valid Palindrome: return true if `s`, ignoring non-alphanumerics and case, reads the same forward/backward.
Best Time to Buy/Sell Stock (single transaction): given prices[], return max profit.
Contains Duplicate: return true if any value appears at least twice.
Move Zeroes: in-place, move all 0s to the end while keeping relative order of non-zeros.
First Unique Character in a String: return the index, or -1.
Valid Parentheses: given a string of `()[]{}`, return true if brackets are balanced.
Merge Two Sorted Arrays into a new sorted array.
Odd Occurrences in Array (Codility): every element appears twice except one — find the one.
questions.explanation:
```js
function odd(A) { return A.reduce((x, y) => x ^ y, 0); }
```
XOR trick — O(n) time, O(1) space.

questions.prompt: Cyclic Rotation (Codility): rotate array right by K positions.
PermMissingElem (Codility): array contains 1..N+1 with one missing — find it.
FrogJmp (Codility): min jumps of size D from position X to reach Y.
Reverse a Linked List (iterative).
Max Depth of Binary Tree.
Best time complexity to find if a value exists in a sorted array of length n?
questions.explanation: Binary search.

questions.prompt: Time complexity of `Array.prototype.sort()` in V8?
questions.explanation: V8 uses TimSort — O(n log n) worst-case.

questions.prompt: Reverse a string in-place (given a mutable char array).
Group Anagrams: given string[], group anagrams together.
Product of Array Except Self (no division).
